test_policy: Causal foundation and real same-stack behavior only; connector scripts carry exact operation/lane proof. F01/F02/AUTH/PG packet-scoped acceptance extends the named existing entrypoints without inventing duplicate global IDs or proof runners. All commands are future commands, unexecuted here.
cache_policy: Go build cache reused. go test -c compiles only. Cached successful tests are not fresh physical proof. Exact relevant code/schema/assertion/source changes invalidate; unknown dependency closure conservatively invalidates scope.
proof_status: planned is distinct from implemented, locally_verified, provider_tested and live_certified; fake never live certification.
